title: Certify sharp P104 prefix norms and completed-error guards
body:
The complete frozen PR5802 word has sharp maximum field amplification **2^17**, attained by an explicit two-input fixture. Under its retained unitary native charts, this applies to physical Hilbert norms at every admitted column multiplicity. Exact signed error propagation gives `E <= 56663088*u*B/(1-2428962*u)`: **26 guard bits for all prefixes, 23 for final public outputs**. The native-only model needs25 and19. No new kappa is claimed.

The independent-defect gains are also sharp:1361937 over all prefixes and65823/2 at final outputs. Literal executions attain them. All798 input columns and every final error coefficient are checked by forward and transpose algorithms. Reverse covectors check every attaining row and all30 pre-erasure ideal rows. **29 clears erase nonzero ideal data**, so the old known-zero recovery theorem cannot justify them.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05c15af1393f7d737fa316b507638a50f20d4925/research/p104-sharp-norm-error/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05c15af1393f7d737fa316b507638a50f20d4925/research/p104-sharp-norm-error/RESULT.json), [sources](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05c15af1393f7d737fa316b507638a50f20d4925/research/p104-sharp-norm-error/SOURCES.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/05c15af1393f7d737fa316b507638a50f20d4925/research/p104-sharp-norm-error/VALIDATION.md).

Python3.12.14 standard-library normal and optimized registered checks pass, with six actual source corruptions and exact guard/reset/COPY controls. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and the official18-file export pass. The read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH passed in15.03seconds; all19 files including the manifest remained unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-sharp-norm-error
```

This is a conditional completed-operation precision lemma, not a rounded child or a proof of the minimum precision of an implementation. COPY, INIT and CLEAR are exact premises. Native maps/phases, internal child and wrapper errors, physical recovery, tape cost and all five framework assumptions remain. The method credits Adam Gall, ywz65 and PR2878; the new contribution is the full changed word's sharp transfer and guard bounds. PR5802 and its retained notices supply construction/native lineage. No predecessor executable is imported.
